title: Runtime Identity Contract v1
description: Runtime identity emitted by the device suite. v1 is atomic with firmware; only schemaVersion 1 is supported.

schemaVersion.description: Locked to 1 for v1. Bump only when fields change type/semantics or are removed.

modelId.description: Hardware model identifier (e.g. M11R4). Must not be empty.

customerId.description: Customer identifier (e.g. 0007). Must not be empty.

backend.description: Backend engineering identifier (e.g. mercku_mtk7621). Must not be empty.

detectedCapabilities.description: Optional hardware-existence detection results. Keys must be a subset of CAPABILITY_KEYS; must not carry brand/menu/frontend state.
